entities.name: Diet of Worms
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Imperial assembly in 1521 where Martin Luther was summoned to recant his writings. His refusal — "Here I stand, I can do no other" — marked the point of no return for the Protestant Reformation, leading to his excommunication and the Edict of Worms.
